intro.message: Are you ready to begin your study journey with me?

rules.message: Awesome! Before we get started, let me explain the rules.
Each level must be completed and passed before moving on to the next.
If you fail a level, you'll need to retry it until you pass.
Locked levels will remain inaccessible until you’ve cleared the previous ones.
Now that you know the rules, I assume you're ready...
